exposure: Maternal body mass index at childbirth
Method of childbirth (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
maternal body mass index at childbirth
cohort: 170 pregnant women in the third trimester of pregnancy referring to Shahroud Health Care Centers (Semnan, Iran)
finding: A decision tree model using previous method of childbirth, maternal BMI at childbirth, maternal age, and estrogen levels as predictors was able to predict method of childbirth with high accuracy (89.57% accuracy in the training set and 83.33% accuracy in the testing set).
mod_finding: The study found previous mode of delivery to be a significant predictor of childbirth method.
